concept: Review and integration: what noticing and appreciating good things feels like so far
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Of noticing small good things, giving specific thanks, and finding good on hard days — which do you want to practice most?
exercise.practice: Student summarizes, in their own words, what 'gratitude' means so far

assessment.success_marker: student offers a personal definition connecting to at least one prior story
